issue.title: test_stop_live_inline_run_settles_stop_requested hits 'tool run store is busy: database is locked' under the full lane, passes in isolation
issue.description: Load-sensitive ToolRun store lock contention in tests/tool/test_lifecycle_controls.py; see the flake report.

task_type_fields.evidence: Proposed by sase-18f.3 (PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP #4, epic sase-18f green-check). In a full `just test` lane on clean master (2026-09-24) the node failed with `tool run store is busy: database is locked`; it then passed 3/3 in isolation on the unchanged tree (~3.9s each). Fail rate: 1 full-lane failure, 0/3 serial. The failure is SQLite busy contention on the ToolRun store under full-suite load, not a deterministic defect; the precise lock holder was not identified, so no narrower size is claimed.

payload.entry:
Closed by epic sase-1ou landing (phase sase-1ou.2, child epic sase-1ou.2.1).
- Root cause: ToolRun SQLite store contention at open, schema, WAL and last-close.
- Core 6d11122e skips redundant schema writes, retries busy at the store boundary within one elapsed budget, persists WAL without checkpoint-on-close, and moves retention filesystem work out of the writer. Core 3f8baa79 counts the WAL probe against that budget. sase 57d5f411e4 pins the core and delegates default budgets to Rust.
- Controlled 400 ms last-close overlap: old show failed 10/10, fixed show passed 10/10.
- Landing re-verify on master 86c3250e69: tests/tool/ passed 3 x 480 at -n6 under 24 CPU spinners, with no 'database is locked'. 0 tests/tool/ failures in 67 local full-lane records since 57d5f411e4, and none in four post-fix scheduled Full CI runs.
- The epic's own new sase-core contention tests flaked under load; that is sase-1p6, fixed in this landing.
- Baseline: the three nodes with per-node proof are retired with fixed-at. The six residual nodes never recorded the SQLite busy signature. They moved to their own owners (sase-1fi, sase-1p2), or dropped out where closed owners sase-1f0, sase-1jl and sase-1gi postdate every failure.
- sase-19t stays open because its report has no exception signature to attribute.
